rows.31:3cdc:
No, no more words are needed.
How it turns out is your own problem.
But everyone who saw that painting died, without fail.
Soon, and certainly......
At least, the four so far did.
Will you be the fifth? Or will I be the fifth, and you the sixth......
Let's hope it doesn't come to that.{p}
rows.31:41f0:
Hmm, so you dislike them.
Should you really say something like that?
After all, a painting holds the feelings of the person who painted it.
It's affected by their mood while painting, too, but which feeling do you think is the strongest?
......That's right: the wish to be seen by someone.
Artists all seem to have that urge to show themselves off, to some degree.
Though I suppose that's how it should be.
But the feelings poured into a painting like that gradually become one with the painting.
And then the painting itself begins to wish that someone would look at it.
Have you ever heard stories about the eyes of a portrait moving to look at you?
Or people slipping out of paintings and walking around?
They do that because they want to stand out, too.
With that one single wish, 'Look at me,' they'll do even unbelievable things.
That's how strong the feeling is.{p}
rows.31:4fac:
Say, {a}{f:|}.
What became of that unfinished painting... can you imagine?
The one I hung in the art room, I mean.
The truth is, it was finished.
Strange, isn't it? Shimizu was supposed to have been killed before she finished it.
I'll tell you how such a thing could happen.{p}
rows.31:58bc:
That painting...... don't you feel as if it's glaring at you?
..........What's wrong?
You've gone white as a sheet.
Did you see something, maybe?
Like the painting's face changing..........
Though that's just something I made up.
Come on, let's go.{p}
rows.31:59b0:
......But, {a}{f:|}?
If you really did see something, you'd better be careful.
You might be being sent a message.
If you don't notice it and ignore it......
Oh, I don't even want to think about that, do you?{p}
